en.hubeali:
Sahl, from Bakr Bin Salih, from Malik Bin Asheym, from one of his companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>

having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Marry her (for her) large eyes, brunette (colour), (large) buttocks, medium stature, so if you dislike her, upon me<sup>asws</sup> would be the dower’.
en.sarwar: 7. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Bakr ibn Salih from certain persons of his people who have said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘It is of the well-being of a man who on moving aside the veil of a woman finds her white.’”
